question_text: A local government unit plans to reduce the budget for public schools in the municipality to fund a new infrastructure project. Under Article XIV of the 1987 Constitution, which of the following statements best describes the state's duty regarding education?

options.text: The state may prioritize infrastructure over education as long as the schools are still operational.
The state must protect and promote the right to quality education at all levels and ensure that adequate funding is allocated.
The state has no constitutional duty to fund education; it is solely the responsibility of parents.
The state must provide free education only at the elementary and secondary levels, but may reduce funding for tertiary education.
